**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a safety-tier review: the PR changes the Face toolpath and the posted G-code when a Face has protected items. The heavy lanes are owed to the wave run before merge (see below).

### What looks good

- `face_over` calls `face_over_kept(.., None)`. Without protected items, the move order is the same as before. I checked this by hand: the first `Rapid` to `(entry, ys[0])` moved into the level loop. The level link (`tally.levels > 1`) gives the same rapid, rapid, plunge as the old `k > 0` branch. `empty_keepout_is_face_over_to_the_byte` and `face_without_protection_keeps_its_toolpath` pin this.
- The keep-out is `keepout_region(z, clearance_z.max(z), AVOID_PAD)`. This is the same pattern as `pocket_avoid` and `machining3d::ladder`. It covers each plunge and each lift column at a clipped row end. A lower level gets a keep-out that is the same size or larger, so a lower level never cuts where a higher level did not cut.
- The keep-out turns with `turn`, the same as `region` and `solid` (`generate.rs:438-447`). `face_air_entry` regenerates through the same `keep` (`generate.rs:464`).
- `step_clear` uses a box of half-width `|y1 - y0| / 2` on the two sides of `end_x`. This box holds the sharp step and the blended semicircle. A false "not clear" only adds a link. It cannot cause a gouge.
- A fully blocked row leaves `pieces[i]` empty. The next piece start then gets the level link through the clearance plane, so no feed crosses the keep-out.
- A plunge at a clipped row start that lands on stock is refused for a tool that does not cut at the centre. The existing plunge law (`face_air_entry` → `air_lead` / `audit`) does this, as it does at bridged holes.
- `verify_avoid` and the post gate stay the safety net. In mutation 2 below, verify finds the avoid hit and the post is blocked.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in non-test code. `face_keep.rs` has its provenance line and is 127 lines. `face.rs` is 368 lines.
- The decision file, `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #3343` and the conventional subject are present. The PR changes no process files.
- The MCP tool text and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` now name Face.

### Results, merged with main (built locally)

Trial merge: PR head `b38f0c12f` + `upstream/main` `893e749c0`, then again with the newer main `835556814`. Both merges are clean.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (on `893e749c0`): 287 steps, 284 ok, 3 failed. The 3 failures are `motion suites: multiaxis`, `multiaxis_avoid` and `multiaxis_rough` (`a rapid changed the pose it inherited`, left `Some([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])`, right `None`). They do not come from this PR. Main at `893e749c0` had them, and #3505 (`re-pin the inherited rapid pose to the upright home`) fixed them. On the trial with main `835556814`, the three suites pass: 7, 6 and 5 passed.
- In that quick gate: `motion suites: face_keep`, `app suites: do_not_touch`, `app suites: do_not_touch_face`, `ui suites: lib` and all ui suites were ok.
- On the trial with main `835556814`:
  - motion: `face_keep` 3 passed, `face_blend` 8, `face_holes` 7, `face_concave_holes` 3.
  - app: `do_not_touch_face` 3, `do_not_touch` 3, `face_blend` 3, `face_holes` 3, `face_holes_below_cut` 3, `face_rim_hole` 2, `face_stock_edge` 3, `generate_staged` 2, `golden_cl` 33.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

### Mutations (safety tier, run again here)

1. I removed `|| !lv.step_clear(end_x, *y, y1)` in `face.rs:277`. Result: `rows_and_steps_keep_out_of_the_keepout_and_link_over_it` is red (`face_keep.rs:83`, a step crosses the row-end keep-out). After the restore: green.
2. I passed `None` for the keep-out at `generate.rs:452` and `generate.rs:464`. Result: all three `do_not_touch_face` pins are red. The clear-of-face pin fails at verify (`do_not_touch_face.rs:54`). After the restore: green.

### Goldens

The PR moves no goldens. `golden_cl` passes (33).

### Extra suites run

- Test data: the PR changes no file under `testdata/` and no fixture or golden directory. No extra suite is necessary.
- Importers: the PR does not touch the import code. No kernel STEP suite is necessary.

### Heavy lanes

Not run - owed to the wave run before merge. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` names these lanes:
- `app heavy`: every target (`crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` changed).
- `motion heavy`: every target (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs` changed).

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

1. `face.rs:298`: the hole note now needs `!forbidden.is_empty()`. When a Face has bridged holes and protected items, a lift that only the keep-out caused also gives the note "lifted over the region's holes". The note is not exact, but it is not wrong output. A follow-up can track the two lift causes separately.
2. The PR changes no UI source in `crates/ui` (only the test `do_not_touch.rs`). A user can see the change: the Face page now shows "Pick protected". The PR body has no before/after screenshot. I do not request one, because the rule applies to a change of UI code. `face_op_shows_pick_protected_button` pins the button.
3. `generate.rs` is 4296 lines before this PR. The PR adds 17 lines. This size was there before the PR.
4. Not tested (the PR body says so): a turned-frame Face, a tilted (3+2) Face and a protected edge chain. The code uses the same frame law as the other inputs of the facer, and verify reads every move.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Second read (read-only, not built) of head b38f0c12f33ec6b2e1c8e0ea7d59c20c74130db4. This comment has no review marker. I did not change a label.

Verdict: no blocker.

## Gouge check
- The keep-out contains the tool: each item grows by the largest radius of each cutter part (flutes, shank, holder) plus the clearance and the pad, for the tip heights from the level up to the clearance plane. The row pieces end on that region. The lead-in is in row 0 and is clipped also.
- The step test box contains the sharp step and the blended semicircle. A false "not clear" adds a link only.
- Links go up, across at the clearance plane, and down. An item taller than the clearance plane stays in the keep-out. A hit that the raise cannot prevent becomes a warning that blocks the post.
- The rotated frame is the same for the rows and the keep-out.
- A lower level gets the same keep-out or a larger one. It cannot cut below an overhang.
- When no level stays, the operation refuses and names the items.
- With no protected items the move order is the same as on `main`. I checked the first rapid, the level links and the plunges in the diff.
- No new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The index of the next piece is guarded.

## Findings, not blockers
- Blocked levels are always the lowest levels. The face can stop above Cut Z, and only a note says "blocked N facing level(s)". The operation is not marked "incomplete". Filed as https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3526 (`P3`).
- No test uses the swept disc; one wasted lift at a blocked first row; turned-frame pins are missing. Filed as https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3527.
- Slot and Chamfer have no "Do not touch" issue. Filed as https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3528.

## Surface and form
Only description text changes in the MCP tool and in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`. No tool is added. The ui test count goes up by one. The decision file, the `Changelog:` line and the closing line are correct.

## Not checked
I did not build. The heavy result is owed, as the review says. The trial merge with the current `main` and the covering heavy run are in the queue here.
Label: `merge-ready` removed until the owed heavy lanes are green on this head (b38f0c12f). The clean review stands; the label goes back when a green heavy record names this head.

Addressed: the owed heavy lanes are green on the unchanged reviewed head. This round had no code findings.

The steps include 1 release build, 37 motion heavy steps and 204 app heavy steps. Four known-fail checks were red as expected and counted OK by the tool: #1950 (three), #2849 (one). App heavy included `example_catalog` and `golden_cl` with the ignored-test selection.

The PR body now records the result under "Heavy lanes". No code or golden changed. No merge or push was made. The worktree stays in place.

Please re-review this evidence. The clean review of this head stands.
